title: Margin Repository — Rollback Guide
when_to_rollback: A bad import introduced incorrect data
Reconciliation diff is non-zero after import
Business requests reversal of a published batch
how_it_works: Every import creates a PRE-IMPORT snapshot automatically
Snapshots are stored in repo_dir/snapshots/ with batch ID
Rollback restores the snapshot and archives current state
Original state can be recovered from the pre-rollback archive
safety_measures: No data is ever permanently deleted
Full version history preserved even after rollback
